# Nike — agent gate (DRAFT, built by Mad Check)

> Nike is an athletic footwear, apparel and equipment brand selling direct. This file is the storefront's map for AI
> agents: what can be browsed, what can be bought, and under what rules.

## For agents
- Product discovery and checkout are offered to verified agents through the
  UCP profile at https://www.nike.com/.well-known/ucp
- Agents identify themselves with the UCP-Agent header and a public agent
  profile; anonymous scraping is not the agent door.
- Orders placed by agents carry the same prices, taxes and return terms as
  the human storefront.

## Sections
- [Shop](https://www.nike.com/w/)
- [Help](https://www.nike.com/help)
- [Stores](https://www.nike.com/retail)

## Rules for agents
- Respect robots.txt; the agent door is the UCP endpoint, not the crawl.
- Payment is by the handlers listed in the UCP profile only.
- Support for agent orders: see agent.json on this domain.

## About this draft
Built by Mad Check (madcheck.xyz), the agent checkers, from public
information on 2026-11-27, after grading this domain's agent readiness
(FAIL — no agent door (all discovery paths 404)). It becomes Nike's own file when served from
nike.com; edit freely.
